summary: Comprehensive testing of BTP Manager Pôles Users and AI Chat features completed successfully. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: 'Domaine' renamed to 'Pôle' throughout UI, users toggle on Pôles page works, unassign buttons visible, AI chat panel opens and responds with platform data analysis.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay intercepts clicks on AI toggle button - requires force=True or JavaScript click
ui_bugs.workaround: Use JavaScript click or force=True in Playwright

backend: Login with Direction account (superdadmin@gmail.com / Superadmin123!) - 200 OK
GET /api/domaines returns list of pôles with outils
GET /api/domaines/{id}/users returns assigned users with user_id, email, nom, prenom, role_global
POST /api/domaines/{id}/assign auto-assigns tools when assigning user to pôle
POST /api/ai/chat returns AI response analyzing platform data
POST /api/ai/chat with platform analysis question works
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns correct statistics with total_domaines (pôles)
frontend: Pôles page subtitle is 'Gérez les pôles de l'entreprise'
Pôle cards display with users toggle button
Users toggle expands to show assigned users
Unassign button visible on hover for Direction role
Outils page subtitle says 'Gérez les outils par pôle'
AI assistant red floating button visible (bottom-right)
AI chat panel opens with glassmorphism design
AI chat sends message and receives response
AI response correctly analyzes platform data (lists 4 active users)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Emergent badge at bottom-right overlaps with AI toggle button - may cause click interception issues for users
seed_data_creation: Test users created and deleted during testing for assign/unassign tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working: 1) 'Domaine' renamed to 'Pôle' in all UI labels (backend routes remain /api/domaines). 2) GET /api/domaines/{id}/users endpoint returns assigned users. 3) Auto-assign logic works for ALL users when assigned to pôle. 4) AI chat using Claude Sonnet via emergentintegrations - gathers platform data as context. 5) ChatMessage model stores persistent chat history. Existing data: 4 users, 2 pôles (COMMUNICATION, PROD), 4 outils.

poles_users_management.unassign_button: Visible on hover for Direction role
